description: Create the 7 shared Blade components and rewrite the 2 layout files. These are the foundation all page views depend on — implement them first so later FEATs can use x-badge, x-alert, x-empty-state, x-admin.stat-card, x-admin.page-header, x-storefront.product-card, x-storefront.breadcrumb.
steps: Create resources/views/components/badge.blade.php — accepts $variant (emerald|red|blue|gray default=gray) and $text. Renders <span class='rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold'> with variant color: emerald=bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700, red=bg-red-100 text-red-700, blue=bg-blue-100 text-blue-700, gray=bg-slate-100 text-slate-600.

Create resources/views/components/alert.blade.php — accepts $type (success|error) and $message. success=bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800, error=bg-red-50 border border-red-200 text-red-700. Include dismiss button (x) that calls this.closest('[role=alert]').remove() via inline onclick.

Create resources/views/components/empty-state.blade.php — accepts $title, $description, $icon (SVG path d= string), optional $actionLabel, optional $actionUrl. Renders bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm p-16 text-center with icon circle (w-16 h-16 bg-slate-100 rounded-full), h3 title, p description, and optional <a> button link.

Create resources/views/components/admin/stat-card.blade.php — accepts $label, $value, $subtext (optional, default null), $iconPath (SVG path d= string), $iconBg (e.g. bg-blue-100), $iconColor (e.g. text-blue-600). Renders bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6 flex items-center gap-4 with icon circle + value in large bold text + optional subtext.

Create resources/views/components/admin/page-header.blade.php — accepts $title, $createRoute (optional, default null), $createLabel (optional, default '+ New'). Renders
with

$title

on left and optional $createLabel on right.

Create resources/views/components/storefront/product-card.blade.php — accepts $product (Product model). THREE-CASE image logic: str_starts_with($product->image,'http') ? $product->image : ($product->image ? Storage::disk('public')->url($product->image) : asset('images/placeholder.png')). Card: rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all, aspect-square image, orange discount badge (top-left, absolute), category label (text-xs text-slate-400 uppercase), product name (font-semibold text-sm line-clamp-2), price row (bold new_price + strikethrough old_price if old>new), orange 'View Details' button. Link wraps entire card: route('storefront.product', $product->slug).

Create resources/views/components/storefront/breadcrumb.blade.php — accepts $items (array of ['label'=>string,'url'=>string|null]) and $dark (bool, default false). Renders <nav aria-label='Breadcrumb'> with flex items-center gap-1 flex-wrap. Each item: if url is set render <a> with hover underline; last item no link. Separator is › between items. $dark=false means light-on-dark colors (text-indigo-200/text-white), $dark=true means dark-on-light (text-slate-500/text-slate-700).

Rewrite resources/views/layouts/admin.blade.php — FULL REWRITE. Keep @yield('title'), @yield('page-title'), @yield('content'), @stack('scripts'). Body: bg-slate-50 min-h-screen flex. Sidebar: w-64 min-h-screen bg-white border-r border-slate-200 flex flex-col shrink-0. Brand area: blue-600 icon square + 'BanglaPuzzle' font-bold + 'Admin' text-xs chip. Nav links (dashboard, categories, subcategories, products): active=bg-blue-50 text-blue-700 font-semibold rounded-lg, idle=text-slate-600 hover:bg-slate-100 rounded-lg. Keep routeIs() active detection. Logout: POST admin.logout + @csrf. Topbar: bg-white border-b border-slate-200 px-6 py-4 flex items-center justify-between; left=@yield('page-title') h1; right=Auth::user()->name chip. Flash: <x-alert type='success' :message="session('success')" /> inside @if(session('success')) block, same for error. @vite in <head>.

Rewrite resources/views/layouts/storefront.blade.php — FULL REWRITE. Keep @yield('meta_title'), @yield('meta_description'), @yield('og_tags'), @yield('content'), @stack('scripts'). $navCategories available via View::composer — do not add to controller. Keep existing structure: topbar(bg-slate-900 h-9 text-xs) + sticky header(bg-white shadow-sm z-50) + flash(using <x-alert>) + <main> + footer. Keep mobile toggle JS using exactly ids 'nav-toggle' and 'mobile-nav'. Footer three-column grid preserved. @vite in <head>.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 component files exist under resources/views/components/
Both layout files rewritten with new design tokens
php artisan test --compact passes all 55 tests
vendor/bin/pint --dirty --format agent reports no issues on all created/modified files
findings: All 7 components created and both layouts rewritten. 55/55 tests pass. Pint reports no issues. Components: badge (4 variants), alert (success/error with dismiss), empty-state, admin/stat-card, admin/page-header, storefront/product-card (three-case image logic), storefront/breadcrumb (dark/light modes). Layouts updated to slate/blue design tokens with x-alert for flash messages.
